title: Maze demo
consent_html: This is a demo of the maze paradigm of jspsych-fps-lab: a practice maze and two larger mazes, with no monsters. Find the way out of each; a round ends at the exit or when its time is up.
instructions_html:
How to play

W A S D move and the mouse turns. Esc pauses the game.

Each round is a maze. Find the exit: a room whose walls and floor look different. Walking into it ends the round; so does running out of time.

questions.name: difficulty
questions.prompt: How hard was it to find your way?
